name: Crispy rice with kho veal
summary: Kho veal eaten with crispy rice. One wording is cơm cháy bò tơ kho, and another is lemongrass kho veal with the same crisp rice.
origin: Củ Chi. Both names are veal kho with crispy rice. The wording is not the same, so both stay.
howToEat: Eat the kho veal with crispy rice. Cơm cháy bò tơ kho and bò tơ kho sả with cơm cháy both stay. Tuổi Trẻ calls the boiled rice-paper roll the older plate.
The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Crispy rice with kho veal in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Kho Cu Chi veal eaten with crispy rice.
